correctness.rationale: Writing X=(a,b,c,d,e,f), Y=(A,B,C,D,E,F) gives bracket coordinates (aB−bA,bC−cB,aE−eA+dC−cD). For dual functional (alpha,beta,gamma) the alternating form has rank 0 at zero, rank 2 for gamma=0 and (alpha,beta)≠0, rank 4 for gamma≠0; in characteristic two alternating still has even rank. Double additive character sums are q^{12−rank}, Fourier inversion over the 3D target gives exactly the three closed fiber counts. Their multiplicity-weighted sum equals q^12; positivity proves image entire [N,N], and factor-two nonzero central/generic ratio detects the third lower central term. Fresh finite-field direct bracket enumeration verified every target for q=2 and q=3 (64² and 729² pairs). The rank/Fourier proof supplies every prime power, not the finite check.
residual_risks: The rank4 conclusion for gamma≠0 requires observation that no alternating rank6 is possible because central f variable is unused, so support dimension ≤5.
Algebra commutator and group unitriangular word commutator are different maps.

final_claim: The additive commutator map [X,Y] in the strictly upper triangular 4x4 algebra over every finite field F_q has exactly three target-fiber sizes: F(0)=2q^9+q^8−2q^7, F(nonzero central wE14)=2q^9−2q^7, F(uE13+vE24+wE14) for (u,v)≠(0,0) equals q^9−q^7. All targets of the derived algebra occur.
